next.reason: 1985 READ GR10c: 'If the AT END phrase is not specified, a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure must be associated with this file-name-1' (and SR2 refuses a READ lacking both). §2023:14.9.30.4 GR24 keeps status '10', AT END precedence and the USE path, but d) adds 'If there are no applicable at end exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the READ statement', so the requirement is dropped (looser), and a) adds EC-I-O-AT-END 'if enabled'. §2023:14.9.30.4 GR21 and §2023:9.1.13.4 GR1 state when the at end condition exists (no next record, absent optional file); §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 and GR7 state the USE execution and the return to the statement after the READ. A conforming 1985 program behaves the same.
